purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) printing subsystem for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software; handles monthly receipt form printing including hospitalization and outpatient receipts
purpose.summary: ORCR0500 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that prints monthly insurance claim receipts (レセプト). It reads print-control data from a file, dispatches to various receipt format copybooks (HCM/HCN series), and writes formatted print data records. It also manages job-control DB updates and error file output.

notable_features: 75 COPY statements referencing versioned receipt-layout copybooks (HCM18–HCM49, HCN21–HCN51)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM passed via shell/subprocess invocation
UNSTRING of comma-delimited COMMAND-PARAM for parameter parsing
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organisation for print output
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — DB access via subprogram calls (MCP pattern)
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP; decoded as latin-1 so Japanese comments appear as mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (~26% of 61229 bytes); PROCEDURE DIVISION logic is only partially visible. Dialect identified as GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based on ORCA project context and Linux-style file assignments.
